# Relay-14

> Relay-14 is an x402 facilitator for native zkLTC on the LitVM LiteForge testnet.

The payer signs an EIP-1559 transfer and pays their own gas. Relay-14 checks that transaction, broadcasts it, and waits for the receipt. It never holds funds and has no private key.

This is testnet only. Implement a resource server and a payer against the HTTP API below. Do not depend on `@relay-14/*`. Those packages are private.

## Constants

- Scheme: `exact-native` (not the ERC-3009 `exact` scheme)
- Network: `litvm-testnet`
- Chain id: `4441`
- Asset: `0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000` (native zkLTC, 18 decimals)
- x402 version: `1`
- Payment header: `X-PAYMENT` (standard base64 of the UTF-8 JSON payload, not base64url)
- Response header: `X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE` (standard base64 of the settle JSON)
- Receipt wait: 30 seconds. `maxTimeoutSeconds` must be from 1 to 30
- Facilitator base URL: `https://relay-14-facilitator.compx.io`
- Faucet: `https://liteforge.hub.caldera.xyz`
- RPC: `https://liteforge.rpc.caldera.xyz/http`

`tx.value` must equal `maxAmountRequired`. The first verify binds `resource`, `payTo`, and the amount. `/settle` verifies again, so a resource server may call settle alone. The resource server calls the facilitator. A client-reported settlement is not proof of payment. The server has no key and must not broadcast the signed transaction.

`confirmation_timed_out` and `settlement_in_progress` are HTTP 503 from the resource server, with no new 402. The facilitator itself returns HTTP 200 and puts `success` or `isValid` in the body.

## Site

- [Home](https://relay-14.compx.io/): landing page
- [Docs](https://relay-14.compx.io/docs): scheme, facilitator API, building an endpoint, and paying
- [Transactions](https://relay-14.compx.io/txns): settled payments, newest first, each linked to the LiteForge explorer

## Facilitator

Base URL: https://relay-14-facilitator.compx.io

- [GET /supported](https://relay-14-facilitator.compx.io/supported): schemes this facilitator accepts
- [POST /verify](https://relay-14-facilitator.compx.io/verify): check a signed transfer without broadcasting it
- [POST /settle](https://relay-14-facilitator.compx.io/settle): verify again, broadcast, and wait for the receipt
- [GET /health](https://relay-14-facilitator.compx.io/health): LiteForge RPC and database check
- [GET /transactions](https://relay-14-facilitator.compx.io/transactions): settled payments, up to 50, newest first

## Network

- [LiteForge explorer](https://liteforge.explorer.caldera.xyz): transaction pages linked from the site
- [LiteForge RPC](https://liteforge.rpc.caldera.xyz/http): chain id 4441
- [LiteForge faucet](https://liteforge.hub.caldera.xyz): fund a test payer
